status: frozen before private replay arm execution
snapshot_consistency: two complete identical source reads, not an atomic historical database

contexts.selection: strip query edges; deduplicate canonical normalized query+logged caller project/host; sort SHA256 within strata; take fixed quotas; sort final SHA256
contexts.language: Cyrillic anywhere, else Latin letters anywhere, else other; no semantic language labels
contexts.project: singleton logged tier when present, otherwise empty; no inferred aliases
contexts.host: logged host, fallback to explicit immutable manifest host; never worker/server hostname
contexts.filters: native recall.Query.Filter defaults, OR, no kind/since override, exclude unnamed shelves
contexts.latest: max version before status and expiry; native identical duplicate collapse; conflicting version fails
contexts.floor_diagnostic: native floor 0.6 (message default 0.45) on first 16 selected contexts; never inherit BM25 floors in PG

normalization: native text.Stems, Terms, Prefix with number terms enabled; content alone in candidate lexical index
candidate_schema: full unique history and every remaining metadata field; no keywords/queries; separate primary-only lexical and vectors

model.name: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small
model.passage_population: every latest active fact including facts expired at fixed date; expiry is request-time
model.cache: content-hash dedup for passages, exact text hash for queries; research CLI reads the saved query cache JSON; local existing model bytes, no provider calls

order: cheap native integrity and negative controls, baseline twice, embedding, PG import, warm retrieval; fixed ascending case hash; alternate arm order each repetition

scale.kind: deterministic replicas of latest active real rows/vectors with new performance-only identities; no new diversity or quality evidence
scale.ann: not measured; exact filtered search is oracle; consider ANN in a new declaration if 30000-row exact p95 exceeds 100 ms

cold_semantics: new client/model process with warm OS page cache; no cache flush, server restart or remote-user network claim
path: research CLI and worker-to-tailnet-addressed deployed SQL; same-server client; actual Hermes plugin and remote device remain unmeasured
metrics: overlap@1/5/10 against full and content SQLite
CPU user/system and peak RSS per client stage
PG backend allocated memory if app-role privileges permit; otherwise unavailable
agent_gate: separate synthetic actual-model smoke only after proving tool offers and hidden-context isolation; no private requests, no deterministic retry substitution
acceptance: zero integrity/filter errors; descriptive retrieval/performance only; no production or issue-complete verdict
